findings.summary: reconcileStartingEntries accepts any number of digits in the numeric suffix, but the schema allows at most 6. A registry session like p-planner-1234567 is adopted in memory, then writeRoster refuses it; in up.ts that refusal is not caught, so cli-hierarchy up aborts. Align the patterns or skip registry names that fail the schema pattern before adopting them.
